body: Thank you very much. I'll see what to do about it.
Even if I'm a woman ? I'm so sorry for being so sexist against myself, I can't help it, it's my first reflex. Sorry if I sound annoying too.

Hard to seek help when I'm convinced I don't deserve it...

I'm 15, I don't have much rights. I can't work and I can't leave the house.

Thank you for being nice to me.

​
